hypothesis: Admission and decode require different fixed costs, while admission cost also depends on prompt length. Replacing the two uninformative block features with an admission indicator and prompt-token total should explain substantially more variation.

pcvs.name: running_requests
pcvs.rationale: Models the repeated decode scheduling and cached-request output work.

pcvs.name: waiting_requests
pcvs.rationale: Models per-request admission and new-request output work.

pcvs.name: has_waiting_requests
pcvs.rationale: Allows admission steps to have a different fixed cost from decode-only steps.

pcvs.name: waiting_prompt_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Captures prompt-dependent admission costs hidden by block counts, which were identical to waiting request counts in every measured state.
